title: William John Baker — Family & Biography
body_markdown:
# William John Baker (1831–1919)

**Born:** 1831 in England
**Died:** 1919 in South Australia

Husband of [[Sophia Baker (1829–1901)]] (née March), and father of [[Hannah Baker (1855–1948)]].

He married Sophia March, daughter of [[Joseph March (1797–1883)]] and [[Sophia Webster]], who emigrated from Norfolk, England to South Australia.
